description: This file defines a class 'Compressed' which extends the 'Formatter' class from the same namespace. It implements a CSS/SCSS formatter that outputs compressed/minified code, primarily focusing on formatting CSS blocks without unnecessary whitespace or comments.

classes.name: Compressed
classes.description: A formatter class for outputting minified CSS/SCSS by removing whitespace, comments, and simplifies block formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with settings to output compressed code, setting indentation, separators, and other formatting options.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Outputs the content of a CSS block, excluding comments and formatting it in a single line with minimal whitespace.

methods.name: blockSelectors
methods.description: Outputs the selectors of a CSS block in a compressed format, replacing complex whitespace with minimal separators.
